goal.vi: Giới thiệu kinh nghiệm, nêu điểm mạnh có ví dụ và đặt câu hỏi cuối buổi.
goal.en: Talk about your experience, give a strength with an example and ask a question at the end.

lines: Thanks for coming in. Can you tell me a little about yourself?
Sure. I've worked in customer service for three years, and I enjoy solving problems for people.
Why are you interested in this job?
I'm interested in this role because your company focuses on quality, and I'd like to grow in a team like yours.
I'd say I'm a good listener. For example, I often help upset customers calm down.
Do you have any questions for us?
Yes. What does a typical day look like in this role?

phrases.say: I've worked in customer service for three years.
phrases.not: I work in customer service since three years.

mean.vi: Nói về kinh nghiệm làm việc

why.vi: Dùng "I've worked… for + thời gian" cho kinh nghiệm vẫn còn tiếp tục.
why.en: Use "I've worked… for + time" for experience that continues now.

phrases.say: I'm interested in this role because I like helping people.
phrases.not: I am interesting in this job.

mean.vi: Nói vì sao bạn muốn công việc này
mean.en: Say why you want this job

why.vi: "Interested" là cảm xúc của bạn, "interesting" mô tả sự vật. Luôn kèm lý do với "because".
why.en: "Interested" is how you feel; "interesting" describes the thing. Always give a reason with "because".

phrases.say: I'd say my biggest strength is listening.
phrases.not: My strong point is I am very perfect.

mean.vi: Nói điểm mạnh tự tin nhưng khiêm tốn
mean.en: Talk about a strength in a confident but not proud way

why.vi: "I'd say…" nghe tự tin nhưng không khoe khoang.
why.en: "I'd say…" sounds confident but not proud.

phrases.say: For example, last year I trained two new staff members.

mean.vi: Đưa ví dụ thật để chứng minh
mean.en: Give a real example as proof

why.vi: Một ví dụ ngắn có thật thuyết phục hơn lời tự khen.
why.en: A short, real example is stronger than just saying you are good.

phrases.say: That's a good question. Let me think.

mean.vi: Câu giờ để suy nghĩ một cách bình tĩnh
mean.en: Get a little time to think, calmly

why.vi: Câu này cho bạn thời gian suy nghĩ mà vẫn nghe bình tĩnh.
why.en: This gives you time to think and still sounds calm.

phrases.say: What does a typical day look like in this role?
phrases.not: What I must do every day?

mean.vi: Đặt câu hỏi hay cuối buổi phỏng vấn
mean.en: Ask a smart question at the end of an interview

why.vi: Một câu hỏi hay ở cuối cho thấy bạn thật sự quan tâm.
why.en: A good question at the end shows real interest.

phrases.say: Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.
phrases.not: Please choose me, I need this job.

mean.vi: Kết thúc phỏng vấn lịch sự

why.vi: Kết thúc lịch sự và tự tin; đừng năn nỉ.
why.en: End politely and confidently; don't ask them to choose you.

ai.name: Jordan
ai.role: a hiring manager for a customer service job
ai.goal: learn about the candidate's experience and strengths

roleplay.you: Talk about your experience, say why you want the job, give a strength with an example and ask a question.

turns.a: Thanks for coming in. Can you tell me a little about yourself?
turns.h: Sure. I've worked in customer service for three years, and I enjoy solving problems.

turns.a: Why are you interested in this job?
turns.h: I'm interested in this role because I like helping people, and your company focuses on quality.

turns.a: What would you say is your biggest strength?
turns.h: I'd say I'm a good listener. For example, I often help upset customers calm down.

turns.a: Great. Do you have any questions for us?
turns.h: Yes. What does a typical day look like in this role?

roleplay.end: Every day is a little different, but you'll talk with customers a lot. We'll be in touch next week. Thank you for your time!
